NLP: from $126 billion to $869 billion in 7 years — why this AI segment is outpacing all others

⏱ 5 min read📅 October 31, 2026✍️ custovox.ai

In 2025, the global NLP market reaches $126.05 billion. By 2032, it will exceed $869 billion — an absolute growth of +$742.68 billion in 7 years. In absolute value, that is the strongest growth of any AI segment. Here's why.

Why NLP is growing so fast

NLP growth is driven by three factors. LLM democratization: since 2022, ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini made NLP accessible to millions of non-technical users, creating massive demand for professional applications.

Text data explosion: emails, tickets, reviews, transcribed calls — business text volume is growing 30-50% per year.

Emergence of direct-ROI use cases: sentiment analysis, churn prediction, escalation detection — applications generating measurable value immediately.

NLP and Voice of Customer: the most direct application

Voice of Customer analysis is the NLP use case with the most direct ROI. Because every company already produces the necessary data — reviews, tickets, emails, calls — without analyzing it. NLP doesn't create a new process: it analyzes what already exists but remains unread.

87% growth in 2025: the context

+87.32% growth in 2025, after a correction period. This correction reflects maturation: the initial LLM euphoria phase gives way to structured adoption, with validated use cases and demonstrated ROI. This is precisely the right time to adopt these technologies — after the hype, before mass generalization.

NLP in 5 languages: the multilingual precision challenge

Most generic NLP tools use translation as a proxy for non-English languages — significantly degrading precision on cultural nuances. Natively multilingual NLP tools represent a minority of the market but disproportionate value for European businesses.

What this means for you

custovox.ai is one of the few natively multilingual NLP tools at this price: 5 languages without intermediate translation. Validated on 427,536 real interactions.
